meta.gitRule: STANDING RULE set 14 Aug 2026 - THE TUTOR MUST NEVER RUN ANY GIT COMMAND AGAINST /Users/mansi/Documents/aiml-track. Not commit, not add, and NOT status. Root cause finally identified on 14 Aug: `git status` is not read-only - it acquires .git/index.lock to refresh the index. The sandbox reaches the folder through a mount that cannot unlink the file afterwards ('Operation not permitted'), so the lock is stranded and every later git command fails with 'Another git process seems to be running'. This is the same mechanism behind the three stale lock files found on 11 Aug, previously misattributed to an interrupted process on 7 Aug. The tutor writes files; Harsh runs git from his own terminal. If a lock is stranded, the tutor must say so and give him `rm -f .git/index.lock` rather than attempting to fix it.
